verdict.rationale: Unleash documents official SDKs as the main way to connect applications. The GitHub repo states 15 official client and server SDKs, the docs cite over 30 SDKs across major languages, and the quickstart and homepage show SDK integration and a usage snippet. An independent community comment confirms official clients for Java, Node.js, Go, Ruby and Python. Missing for 10: in-depth per-language SDK reference documentation in the pack, and hands-on evidence of building against the SDKs.
